author: Liu Zhen
description:
After being stranded in the South China Sea following a power failure in July, the Arleigh Burke-class destroyer USS Benfold was towed to Subic Bay in the Philippines for emergency repairs.
The facility is among the repair and maintenance hubs the US Navy has been developing in the region, strategically pushing for allies to perform major maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) work on US naval vessels given the decline of its shipbuilding base at home.


The repair work on the Benfold in the...
title: How Asian shipyards in Japan, Korea and Philippines keep US warships battle ready

author: Ling Xin
description:
China has started an international project to build a three-dimensional satellite network between Earth and the moon that will track solar activity and study some of the universe’s most powerful explosions.
The project plans to send 30 backpack-sized CubeSats into highly elliptical orbits around Earth in the next four years or so, according to the Deep Space Exploration Laboratory, which will lead the project.
The laboratory said on Friday the constellation would “fill a global gap in systematic...
title: China launches plan for 3D satellite network to monitor sun and cosmic explosions

author: Holly Chik
description:
Asia remains shackled by “mental colonisation” despite accounting for over half the global population, a former UN Security Council president has said, while warning that Taiwan remains the region’s most dangerous flashpoint.
“The big mistake that Asians made after the end of colonial rule [is assuming] that the end of physical colonisation would automatically mean the end of mental colonisation,” veteran Singaporean diplomat Kishore Mahbubani told the inaugural Penang Peace Dialogue in Malaysia...
title: Taiwan remains Asia’s ‘most dangerous’ issue, former Singaporean diplomat warns

author: Zhang Tong
description:
Chinese researchers have developed a table-top magnetic sensor that operates at room temperature and can spot magnetic signals a billion times fainter than the Earth’s own field.
The Levitated Magnet Magnetometer (LeMaMa) functions like a compass with a needle that floats in mid-air with virtually no friction. By tracking the needle’s tiny deflections, the team can measure magnetic fields down to the femtotesla level – an advance that could widen the hunt for elusive dark matter particles or...
title: Chinese-German team builds ultra-sensitive ‘floating compass’ to hunt dark matter

author: Agence France-Presse
description:
Rescuers pulled out a 64-year-old Nepali woman alive on Saturday from her home, buried under thick mud and debris when the region was struck by massive flooding 10 days ago, killing over 1,300 people and leaving at least 5,500 missing.
Emergency personnel said earlier they had rescued a Chinese man, named only as Luhaitao, found alive inside a 225-metre tunnel of the Upper Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project in Nepal’s Rasuwa district.
Footage ‌shared by the Nepali army showed him being given...
title: Chinese man, Nepali woman found alive 10 days after flood

author: Orange Wang
description:
China and Canada’s armed forces held their first round of talks in eight years on Friday in the face of growing tensions with the United States.
The Chinese defence ministry said there had been a candid and in-depth exchange of views on international and regional issues of common concern.
“[Both sides] expressed willingness to strengthen practical exchanges and cooperation between the two militaries, and enhanced mutual understanding and trust,” the ministry added.
It was the first meeting...
title: Canada and China thaw continues as militaries hold first talks in 8 years amid US pressure

author: Ling Xin
description:
In a rare study, Chinese aerospace researchers have explored how a war could one day spill into the vast space between the Earth and the moon, with rival spacecraft chasing and evading each other, trying to slip past defences and even blocking strategic routes.
Spacecraft could hide in the complex gravitational environment around the moon, where their trajectories are difficult to predict, before emerging and moving towards targets closer to Earth when needed, according to a team from the...
title: War on Earth could spill over to the moon, Chinese space scientists warn

author: Jevans Nyabiage
description:
Egypt’s expanded currency swap with China may help bring the yuan into wider use in trade and investment, but experts say any reduced reliance on the US dollar will not happen in a hurry.
Chinese President Xi Jinping and his Egyptian counterpart Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi this week backed greater use of their currencies, while linking closer financial ties to plans for new factories, energy projects and digital infrastructure.
A joint statement released on Wednesday during Xi’s state visit to Cairo...
title: China expands currency swap with Egypt as trade ties reach new heights

author: William Zheng
description:
At least one person was killed and 11 are missing after they were buried by a landslide in central China as the region continued to battle severe flooding caused by Typhoon Saudel.
The landslide hit Gaoping, a town in a mountainous area of Jiangxi province, at around 4am on Saturday, according to state broadcaster CCTV.
It said rescue teams were rushing to the disaster site.
The accident followed days of torrential rain brought by the outer bands of Typhoon Saudel and a cold front.
Floodwaters...
title: Typhoon Saudel: days of flooding trigger fatal landslide in central China

author: Lawrence Chung
description:
A rupture between Taiwan’s two opposition parties over a mayoral race threatens to spill into November’s elections and erode the fragile trust underpinning their potential 2028 alliance.
The main opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and smaller Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) have both registered candidates for mayor of Zhubei, the biggest city in Hsinchu county, after weeks of negotiations failed to produce a joint contender.
The KMT has nominated Hsinchu county councillor Wu Hsu-chih, while the TPP’s Chiu...
title: Taiwan’s opposition parties split over mayoral race, threatening 2028 election alliance
